text:
Zoe: Weekend question — who’s up for a low-key ‘slowhack’ (quiet co-work + boardgames) vs a forest ramen micro-picnic? midday, bring whatever you want. poll by reactions :shrug:
Aisha: Ramen please :ramen: I’ll bring extra chopsticks and miso.
Tom: Slowhack for me — have a tiny patch to ship. I’ll bring French press and cookies. :coffee:
Marta: Ramen sounds amazing. @Liam you still have the portable stove and fuel canisters?
Liam: Yup, got 2 canisters. Also down for slowhack if people want snacks & outlets. :grin:
Nora: Either works. Prefer forest if it’s dry — hate soggy buns. :grimacing:
calendar-bot: Event created — "Forest Ramen Micro-Picnic" Sat 12:30PM — RSVP: 5/10. Link: https://calendar.example/evt/3301
Zoe: Quick poll — react with :ramen: for ramen, :computer: for slowhack, :hand: for neither.
Tom: Also — anyone up for a sunrise 8am ride before? short loop, coffee after. :biking_man:
Marta: Snooze for the ride. Maybe join after ramen for a nap instead :laughing:
Aisha: I can bring extra spoons and a little jar of chili oil. Also: @PeopleOps if this clashes with any office events? jk :stuck_out_tongue: 
Liam: If rain, fallback is slowhack in Conf Room B (outlet-rich, snacks allowed).
Zoe: Awesome — i’ll tally reactions and post final plan by 9pm Fri. If you want to carpool DM me. :thumbsup:
